about: Montréal is Québec’s largest city, on an island in the St. Lawrence River. It is Canada’s second-largest municipality and a bilingual cultural, university, and economic centre. A dense historic core and downtown sit beside older neighbourhoods and a large metro area on both shores. About 1.8 million people live in the city proper.
seoSummary: Québec’s largest city, a bilingual cultural and economic centre on the St. Lawrence.
